name: Cha ca
summary: Cha ca is grilled fish finished at the table with herbs. One account is catfish with spring onion and dill; another is snakehead with turmeric and dill.
origin: Hanoi. Vietnam Tourism includes the dish on the city’s list.
howToEat: At the table, with spring onion and dill.

One account is catfish, marinated and grilled, with spring onion and dill. Another is snakehead fried with turmeric and dill, cooked by the Đỗ family on Chả Cá street since 1871, and a further account marinates the fish in turmeric and sautés it in butter, with dill and green onion.
where: Đường Thành. Chả Cá Thăng Long is at 6B Đường Thành, and the same name is also given at 19–21–31 Đường Thành.
seoTitle: Cha ca — Hanoi grilled fish with dill
seoDescription: Cha ca in Hanoi is marinated catfish, grilled, then finished at the table with spring onion and dill, on Duong Thanh.
